description: Documentation source outlining PyTorch modules, including custom module creation, composition, training, state management, initialization, hooks, and advanced features.

classes.name: MyLinear
classes.description: Custom linear module applying an affine transformation, inheriting from torch.nn.Module.

classes.name: Net
classes.description: Simple neural network composed of two MyLinear modules with ReLU activation.

classes.name: BigNet
classes.description: Hierarchical neural network combining multiple modules including MyLinear and Net.

classes.name: DynamicNet
classes.description: Flexible network with dynamically defined submodules using ModuleList and ModuleDict.

classes.name: RunningMean
classes.description: Module maintaining a running mean as a buffer, demonstrating persistent state.

classes.name: StatefulModule
classes.description: Module demonstrating various ways to register parameters and buffers, including non-persistent ones.

classes.name: ModalModule
classes.description: Custom module with behavior that differs between training and evaluation modes.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Defines the computation performed by a module, e.g., affine transformation or network forward pass.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to a module and its submodules, e.g., for initialization.

methods.name: register_buffer
methods.description: Registers a buffer (non-learnable state) with optional persistence.

methods.name: register_parameter
methods.description: Registers a parameter (learnable tensor) with the module.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the module's parameters, including submodules.

methods.name: named_parameters
methods.description: Returns an iterator over parameters with their names.

methods.name: buffers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the module's buffers.

methods.name: named_buffers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over buffers with their names.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Moves parameters and buffers to a specified device or dtype.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Sets the module in training mode.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Sets the module in evaluation mode.

methods.name: register_forward_pre_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook to run before the forward pass.

methods.name: register_forward_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook to run after the forward pass.

methods.name: register_full_backward_pre_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook before the backward pass.

methods.name: register_full_backward_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook after the backward pass.

methods.name: zero_grad
methods.description: Zeros the gradients of all parameters.
